Krychu is a Polish QW player and foremost developer, being the brain and muscle behind a project of modernizing public player statistics.

After initial chats with ever curious {{Player|bps|flag=se}} (''first contact March 16th 2018''), their project idea was spawned. Slowly marinating ideas in close collaboration, the project eventually took to speed and started materialize in 2019. In the first half of 2020 the project is closing in for public release.

==Achievements==
* QWstats - Developer, designer and architect
